description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ReportSearchFilterParams' that specifies methods for retrieving filter parameters related to report searches, such as report ID, sort order, sort field, limit, and offset within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Method to retrieve the report ID for the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Method to retrieve the sort order as a string, referencing the FilterParams::getSortOrder().

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Method to retrieve the sort field as a string or null, referencing FilterParams::getSortField().

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Method to retrieve the limit parameter, referencing FilterParams::getLimit().

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Method to retrieve the offset parameter, referencing FilterParams::getOffset().
